about_the_game:
Demo

Play through the exciting demo of Finding Mom! Follow the development and you can find the full release here on Steam!

Overview

Finding Mom is a Singleplayer Bullet-Hell following a boy who is trying to find his captured mom. Experience the story, and enjoy the atmosphere that is created through handmade pixel art, music, and gameplay.

Gameplay

This game was designed for fast-paced action. Dodge enemies, bullets, and explosions while fighting a swarm of incoming mobs. The game was designed with ease of controls in mind to shoot, parry, roll, and run easily.
